cohort: 382 mothers who delivered at the Komfo Anokye Teaching Hospital (KATH), Kumasi, Ghana, between August and October 2014
finding: The study found a low EIBF rate (39.4%) and identified several factors associated with EIBF and time to initiation of breastfeeding, including antenatal care visits, mode of delivery, and infant rooming-in.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was significantly associated with EIBF (AOR = 0.07, 95%CI: 0.01-0.79, p = 0.031).
